author: KEXP
description:
The Wedding Present  | Beloved English indie rockers The Wedding Present return for a special Live on KEXP session from Seattle's Hidden Hall. With their classic, guitar-driven sound, the band delivers a performance of "Hot Wheels" and more.

Watch the full listener-powered session at the link in our bio.

This session was made as part of our VIP Club Series, special invite-only performances available to VIP Club donors. To learn more about how to take part in special shows like this one, head to kexp.org/donate.
title: The Wedding Present - Live on KEXP
